ValidationRule.description: BOPI-526 The Pricebook for Edu, Travel, Healthcare and B2B must be CPQ
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", IsClosed = false, ISCHANGED(Pricebook2Id), Pricebook2.Name <> 'CPQ', NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,'Statement of Work')), RecordType.DeveloperName != 'Agents', RecordType.DeveloperName != 'Healthcare_SOW', RecordType.DeveloperName != 'Bank_PSP_Partner', RecordType.DeveloperName != 'Strategic_Partner' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Pricebook for this opportunity must be set to 'CPQ' Pricebook.
